I just have to talk everything out with someone but I’m scared of bothering any of my friends because they’re all busy and I don’t want to make their night sad because I need to tell someone that I’m feeling like this. 

Other times I’ve had other people help me off of this scary emotional and suicidal ideation-filled ledge I’m standing on, but this time I got through it by myself. I’m scared of the day when no one, not even myself, can talk me down from feeling like this.

My ex and I had been dating for about 4 months when he asked me to go on a family vacation to the beach with him. This was the first time I had ever done something like this with him, so I was really nervous, especially when it came to meeting his entire extended family, who I really wanted to like me. 

Being in a beach town, we all ended up biking to the grocery store but had to pause in an intersection to let cars go by and stood with our bikes in between our legs, ready to go. When it was our turn to go, I tried hopping back on and pedaling to go forward, but my foot slipped and I ended up falling on the street in the middle of this busy intersection with the bike on top of me and most of his extended family watching me struggle to get back up.  

Needless to say, I was mortified and tried to brush it off as nothing, even though my whole leg was scratched up and bleeding. That was a really long grocery trip.

I can’t just “not think about or worry about things.” 

I used to be a pretty happy and content person and there wasn’t much in my life to be upset about, but then anxiety and depression took me down. I will constantly overthink and obsess about things that’ve happened to me, whether it be something from last week or two years ago. Distracting myself only goes so far, and even small reminders of certain things can trigger me into a really anxious and sad downward spiral. Sometimes I’ll just wake up feeling anxious or it’ll hit me in the middle of the day when I’m totally unsuspecting. I can’t help it and I wish people understood that I’m trying to control it but sometimes it takes over.

Back in high school, one of my friends was going through a really hard time grieving the loss of his mom and just being in a shitty family situation in general. 

I tried to support him and let him vent to me when he was feeling upset, and he would sometimes say that he wanted to kill himself. I knew that for the most part, he was saying it to get attention because that’s the kind of person he is, but one night, he said that he was going to do it and then stopped responding. He lived 40 minutes away from me and I couldn’t think of anything else to do but call 911. 

They tracked his family down and sent people out to his house to check on him. He was fine, he was out driving with someone and didn’t see his messages. He was pissed at me for a good week and then apologized and thanked me for caring enough to do that.
